Listen to 9to5Mac for your daily news summary. 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes, Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, TuneIn and Google Play. If you use Overcast or other podcast players, you can subscribe via our RSS feed.

This episode is sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you get all the little things out of your head and organise them into a simple, elegant system so you won't forget anything and can ease your mental load. It's an easy-to-use to-do app for iPhone, iPad and Mac, packed with powerful tools to help you organise, track and complete tasks more easily and more enjoyably. Every task, handled by Stuff.

9to5Mac Daily records a new episode every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast platform, and we'll deliver new episodes straight to your ears as soon as they're released.

News covered in this episode:

  • Apple announces price increases for Apple TV and Apple One subscription services
  • iPhone 18 Pro pre-order dates may be slightly later than in previous years
  • Report suggests Apple Watch Series 12 may feature always-on heart rate monitoring, along with a brand-new Fitness app
